desc:

To keep the hand-off smooth, please provide:

• A browser-based admin panel with user-role management

title: Financial Data Entry & Organization
desc:
I have several Excel spreadsheets containing raw financial figures that now need to be brought together into a single, well-structured workbook. The focus of this project is strictly data entry and organization: transferring each numeric record accurately, arranging it under clear headings, applying uniform date and currency formats, and setting up basic cross-sheet links so every total rolls up correctly.

Everything is already digital—no PDFs or paper scans involved—so you can work directly from the original Excel files I will share via cloud folder. Consistency is critical; I want to be able to sort, filter, or run quick pivots without hitting hidden blanks, merged cells, or naming inconsistencies.

Deliverables:
• One consolidated Excel workbook with all financial data entered and logically grouped  
• Standardized column titles, data types, and number/date formats across every sheet  
• A brief hand-off note summarizing sheet structure, any assumptions made, and a quick check list I can follow for spot-verification

If you normally use Excel shortcuts, Power Query, or even a light VBA script to speed repetitive entry, feel free—just keep the final file macro-free unless we discuss otherwise. Accuracy matters more than speed, so build in as many double-checks as you like before sending the finished workbook back to me.

title: Technical AI Response Evaluator
desc:
I need every batch of ChatGPT-style answers on technical topics combed through for factual accuracy and for how clearly and appropriately the ideas are expressed. For each response you will pinpoint any incorrect or incomplete statements, note ambiguities in wording or tone, and explain why they matter. Depth is key—I want a detailed error analysis rather than a high-level score.

The work will follow my internal rubric, but you are welcome to help refine that rubric as patterns emerge. Typical workflow:

• Receive a spreadsheet or JSON dump of model outputs  
• Review against trusted technical sources or documentation  
• Record each error with a brief correction, severity flag, and comment on tone/clarity  
• Return a scored sheet plus a short summary of recurring issues for the engineering team

Acceptance criteria  
• Every answer tagged with at least one of: correct, partially correct, incorrect  
• All identified errors linked to a source or rationale  
• Summary highlights at least three widespread problems per batch and suggests fixes

Turnaround on the first test set is flexible but ideally within 48 hours once materials arrive. Reliable communication and independent work are essential because the role is fully remote. If this scope matches your skill set, I’m ready to share the first dataset and guidelines right away.

• Full calculation report (PDF) with static & dynamic analyses, fatigue assessment, and code references
